desc: Leapers started the UTG PRO line of Made in USA products in 2009. Since then, we have grown from one carbine quad rail handguard to offering a wide variety of items. Our manufacturing operation is equipped with dozens of CNCs, including some robot-automated high end machines usually used for making precision aerospace and medical equipment. We also acquired the most advanced RoboShot polymer injection machines to manufacture innovative high quality polymer products. In answering market demands, we dedicated part of our manufacturing space to implement an in-house Cerakote painting facility. The growing popularity and recognition of our UTG PRO products continues to fuel our commitment and endeavor to provide consumers with USA made products that can compete at every level.
